summary: Revised phased implementation plan for the Universal Zero-Download File & Media Viewer. Scopes immediate implementation to Phase 1 only: EphemeralStreamManager (20–50 MB RAM sliding window with automatic zero-fill wipe on exit, background, and crash recovery), expiring Telegram file link refresh, and Media3 ExoPlayer with a custom chunk-based TelegramChunkDataSource for video and audio streaming with seek support and basic playback controls.
